name: Acid Grasp
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d6 + 11) acid damage. A hit creature of medium size or smaller must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained for 1 minute. A creature restrained in this way may make a DC 17 Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end its effect for them for the duration.
